_comment: Example CLIENT config using kind:"account" links (real Telegram user accounts via MTProto) instead of bots - see README.md's 'Real-account links' section. One link here = one pair of real phone numbers (this side's account + the peer side's account) sharing one private channel. Steps: 1) get telegram_api_id/telegram_api_hash from https://my.telegram.org (once, shared by every account link). 2) `vtel account login -phone +15551234567` on this side and on the peer side - each prints its own numeric user ID and a session file path. 3) fill in session (this side's session path), peer_user_id (the OTHER side's printed user ID), and channel_id (a private channel both accounts have joined and can post in) below. The server-side config is the mirror image: its own session/peer_user_id swapped.
